bill_15.jpg.notes: AMBIGUOUS GROUND TRUTH: amount digit deliberately smudged (pencil), genuinely readable as either INR 784 or INR 789. Ground truth set to 784 based on the subtotal (INR 700) + 12% GST (INR 84) math, which is the more defensible reading. Scored with partial credit tolerance in scorer.py's 5% amount threshold to account for this ambiguity. This bill is intentionally used in the write-up to discuss how ground truth was determined for illegible cases.
